about_the_game:
You are a new worker at a mining site tasked with guarding the area over night. You are not allowed to use the conveniently placed shovel and dynamite to continue digging under any circumstance.

If you do...

Operate the DRILLMASTER 9000

Dig down using the mysterious futuristic drill that has a reactor able to convert any item into energy.

Use the MULTITOOL

The mysterious drill comes with a drill gun able to dig into the ground which allows you to find and collect various items.

Or just use the shovel that can't be upgraded if you wish to suffer for an achievement.

Equipment will need UPGRADING

The drill and multitool can be upgraded with the collected energy and the more material you collect, more upgrades will become available to you.

Reach the DEPTHS

The deeper you go, the more interesting items you can find that may or may not have special functions. Eventually you will reach the depth necessary to find the strangest item of them all.

Discover the SECRET

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: 2 GHz Quad-core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz 6-core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Dig, collect resources, upgrade your drill and multitool, go deep underground and find a powerful shiny object.
supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
